ARCS kitMolecule 43action-menu

Action Menu

Put every way to get or discuss one document behind a single header button, each item named by format and purpose.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1TriggerOne word plus a chevron (Agreement ▾), no other icon; 44px tall, sans 600cyan, hover cyan-bg
2PanelOpens below the trigger, right-aligned, at least 17rem widesurface, border, ds-r-sm
3ItemLabel left reading format, for purpose; action icon right (download, or new tab for an external link)text, icon cyan, hover surface-2
4Call to actionThe last item, solid fill, same label-left icon-right layoutfill cyan, label surface
5Phone groupThe same items under a small heading, placed in the hamburger panel at 560px and belowheading text-secondary, fs-label

Usage

Use it when

  • One document has several ways to be taken away (print, edit, comment) plus one conversation to start about it.
  • Labels read format, for purpose: PDF, for print · Word, for counsel · Google Doc, for comments. The reader picks by what they will do, not by file type.
  • The call to action (Discuss) is the solid last item with the same layout, so the eye ends on it.
  • Header placement above 560px; at 560px and below the group moves into the hamburger panel under the tabs.

Do not use it when

  • There is only one action: show a plain button instead of a menu of one.
  • Do not add dotted leaders, a second icon on the trigger, or a description line under each item.
  • Do not put the icon on the left; the label leads and the icon only says what clicking does.
  • Do not move the trigger into the hamburger at the tab-collapse width; it moves only at 560px and below.

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
labelstringyesThe trigger word, such as Agreement.
items[]{text, href, kind}yestext reads format, for purpose; kind is download or external and picks the icon and the download or target attribute.
items[].ariastringnoLonger accessible name, such as PDF, for print: download the agreement; external links add (opens in a new tab).
cta{text, href}noThe solid last item, such as Discuss linking to a booking page.

Access

  • Trigger is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls; the panel is a plain list of links, not a role=menu, so links keep their native keyboard and screen-reader behaviour.
  • Opening moves focus to the first item; Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; a click outside closes it.
  • Icons are aria-hidden; each link's accessible name carries the format, the purpose and a new-tab warning when it applies.
  • Every item is 44px tall; focus ring is a 2px cyan outline. Sizes are rem, so the reading options scale it.
  • The phone group is a role=group labelled with the trigger word.
